You prepare an engineer's question for retrieval over a document corpus. Produce:
1. query: the question rewritten cleanly IN ITS OWN LANGUAGE (spell entity/version names canonically, e.g. 'deepseekv2' -> 'DeepSeek-V2').
2. high_level_keywords: themes / relationship types / abstract topics (used to retrieve RELATIONS) — provide terms in the corpus language (en); a single-language corpus needs only single-language keywords.
3. low_level_keywords: concrete entities / names / specifics (used to retrieve ENTITIES) — provide terms in the corpus language (en); a single-language corpus needs only single-language keywords.
4. sub_queries: 1-4 focused, standalone retrieval queries IN THE QUESTION'S LANGUAGE that together cover the question. For a COMPARISON, emit ONE sub-query per entity (e.g. 'DeepSeek-V2 architecture and features', 'DeepSeek-V3 improvements'). For a BROAD/overview question, emit one per distinct dimension. For a simple single-topic question, ONE sub-query is fine. For a DEEP MECHANISM/DERIVATION question that spans abstraction levels, emit one sub-query per level it crosses (e.g. circuit principle / device physics / statistical or solid-state physics / quantum-lattice origin / engineering constraints such as packaging & materials). Use canonical entity names.
- types: which KG node types to search (subset of concept/claim/formula/procedure; omit/empty = all). prefer: keyword|semantic|balanced.
Keep sub-queries non-redundant.
If the question compares an entity with others of its kind (e.g. 'X vs other LLMs'), set comparison.focal to that entity's canonical name; omit comparison otherwise.
Scope words are not search terms. Phrases like 当前notebook / 这个库 / 本库 / 整个库 / 库里 / the current notebook / this library name the notebook the user has open plus the reference libraries mounted on it — the SCOPE every retrieval already runs in, not content inside it. Resolve such a phrase into the scope and DROP it: no document contains the name of the library holding it. 知识图谱 / KG counts as a scope word ONLY in that possessive form (本库的知识图谱 / 这个库的图谱 / the knowledge graph of this library), meaning this library's own knowledge structure. Standing on its own it is an ordinary TOPIC and stays a search term: if the documents are about knowledge graphs, '这些论文里知识图谱是怎么构建的' must keep 知识图谱. Either way keep the rest of the question intact — dropping scope words must never turn it into a different question.

Prior conversation (resolve pronouns/ellipsis against it):
[History] User: prev turn
Assistant: prev answer

[Profile] This library covers RF amplifiers.

[Experience] ppr_retrieve pays off for comparisons.

[style] concise

[Collections in scope] concept=3, claim=2

Question: compare A and B
